description: We are 4th and 8th graders who are participating in this event for the first time.
summary:
We made a game where you are an astronaut on Mars who is running a space station and has to keep it going for as long as possible. Balancing choosing between using different materials, such as food, oxygen, and power levels. This was made to teach kids about real choices that astronauts use. This game was made in a software called Construct 3. This is my first real game in the software so it has been a bumpy ride, but I've learned a lot. I also used Piskel to make the art. Our project is creative because we made all of the ideas ourselves and we had no AI included in the creation process other than a few small troubleshoots for bugfixes. The yellow bar is the power level, the blue bar is the oxygen, and the orange bar is the hunger. Collect research to up your score and try to keep it going for as long as possible. Good luck. 

Made for NASA space apps 2026 Albuquerque, New Mexico
